dataset: SkillShift AI six-career source-separated AI exposure evidence

ilo.title: Gmyrek et al. 2025 ILO Working Paper 140 / authors dataset
ilo.adaptation_notice: This is an adaptation of copyrighted ILO material; it has not been prepared, reviewed or endorsed by the ILO.

oecd.mapping_note: Existing verified mapping retained; US occupation evidence, not an official MASCO-O*NET crosswalk.
oecd.interpretation: Higher reversed normalized index indicates smaller AI capability gap; not job displacement or a Malaysia-specific rate.

ilo.measurement: Potential exposure of occupational tasks to generative AI, not predicted job loss.
ilo.occupation_mean_score_status: Not in the provided 4digits_with_tasks.xlsx; do not calculate or label a published mean from this file.

malaysian_context.evidence_note: Low AI impact is based on TalentCorp's Software Engineer classification, not an independently calculated prediction.
malaysian_context.occupation_mapping_note: Malaysian Software Developers (MASCO 2512) mapped to TalentCorp ICT Software Engineer and ESCO software developer (ISCO 2512). These occupation records are not identical.

user_facing_explanation.impact_summary: Generative AI may change parts of software development, especially work involving written requirements, code-related documentation and testing. The ILO identifies meaningful potential task exposure, while a Malaysian TalentCorp study describes its related Software Engineer role as low AI-impacted; these are different measures, not directly conflicting forecasts.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Testing and validation procedures are included in the ILO occupation tasks. AI-assisted test suggestions may support this activity, but the workbook does not measure real-world adoption.
Software-system design and development are documented occupational tasks. AI tools may assist selected design or coding activities, subject to verification.

user_facing_explanation.human_responsibilities: Engineers remain responsible for checking whether designs meet requirements, validating outputs, resolving defects and making contextual trade-offs.
user_facing_explanation.occupation_specific_limitations: The Software Engineer profile used by TalentCorp is not identical to MASCO Software Developers. Exact OECD occupation code is unavailable.
user_facing_explanation.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

limitations: The OECD, ILO and TalentCorp assessments use different methods and cannot be averaged.
AI capability overlap and GenAI exposure are not job replacement probabilities.
International occupational evidence is not a measured Malaysian employment or AI-adoption rate.

malaysian_context.evidence_note: TalentCorp identifies Cost Accountant, Internal Auditor and General Ledger Accountant among medium AI-impacted GBS roles. No single AI-impact level is assigned to the entire MASCO 2411 occupation.
malaysian_context.occupation_mapping_note: MASCO 2411 Accountants and Auditors is broader than the Finance and Accounting Function roles covered by the TalentCorp GBS study.

user_facing_explanation.impact_summary: AI may assist with selected financial-information and reporting tasks. Potential exposure does not remove requirements for audit evidence, financial accuracy, professional judgement or accountability. TalentCorp reports medium impact for selected finance and accounting specialisations only.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: The ILO task list includes preparing and certifying financial statements; AI assistance with drafting or reviewing information is a potential use, not a confirmed replacement.
The ILO lists profit forecasts and budget reporting as occupational tasks that may be affected by information-processing AI.

user_facing_explanation.human_responsibilities: Qualified professionals must review financial conclusions, assess unusual cases, maintain ethical judgement and meet applicable professional obligations.
user_facing_explanation.occupation_specific_limitations: ILO ISCO 2411 covers Accountants, while the Malaysian profile combines Accountants and Auditors. The TalentCorp impact label applies only to specified GBS roles.

malaysian_context.evidence_note: TalentCorp E&E report printed pp. 28–29 (PDF p.15) discusses industry trends, not occupation-wide risk for all electrical engineers.
malaysian_context.occupation_mapping_note: E&E specialist roles in TalentCorp report do not map directly onto all MASCO 2151 engineers.

user_facing_explanation.impact_summary: Electrical engineering includes physical systems, safety and design decisions, so the ILO GenAI study places this occupation in its Not Exposed group. That label does not mean other forms of AI, such as predictive-maintenance systems, are irrelevant; TalentCorp describes AI uses in the E&E sector.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Electrical power-system design is a documented engineering task. AI tools might support selected analyses, but this ILO task score alone does not establish actual deployment.
Establishing performance and safety procedures is an occupational responsibility; software support does not replace professional accountability.

user_facing_explanation.human_responsibilities: Engineers must evaluate physical constraints, standards, system safety and real-world performance before approving designs or changes.
user_facing_explanation.occupation_specific_limitations: ILO evaluates GenAI task exposure, while OECD considers broader AI capabilities and TalentCorp discusses E&E industry trends. These cannot be merged into one impact grade.
user_facing_explanation.editorial_basis: ILO ISCO-08 occupation tasks, project career skills and existing Malaysian context; AI use cases are possibilities, not measured adoption.

malaysian_context.evidence_note: No nursing occupation-wide AI-exposure or job replacement risk determined from the Medical Devices report.
malaysian_context.occupation_mapping_note: MASCO group 2221 is broader than the Professional Nurse 2221-01 skills profile used as a representative specialization.

user_facing_explanation.impact_summary: Nursing combines patient-facing care, clinical assessment and communication. The ILO rates the occupation Not Exposed under its 2025 GenAI framework, but this does not rule out AI tools supporting clinical information and administrative tasks. Safe clinical practice requires qualified human oversight.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Health education is an ILO-listed task for Nursing Professionals; AI could support information preparation if checked by qualified staff.
Patient and family communication is an ILO task; AI-generated information would require clinical verification and sensitivity to context.

user_facing_explanation.human_responsibilities: Nurses remain responsible for patient assessment, safe medication administration, compassionate communication, care decisions within their scope and escalating clinical concerns.
user_facing_explanation.occupation_specific_limitations: US Registered Nurses and Malaysian Nursing Professionals have different regulatory and scope-of-practice contexts. Online training is not a substitute for clinical qualification.

malaysian_context.evidence_note: No occupation-wide AI-impact grade or job-replacement probability is asserted for Data Professionals.
malaysian_context.occupation_mapping_note: MASCO 2524 covers Data Scientists, Data Analysts and other data professionals; no precise O*NET-SOC equivalence has been verified.

user_facing_explanation.impact_summary: Data-oriented work may be affected by AI-assisted statistical analysis and data-management tools. However, the ILO dataset has no direct ISCO-08 category equivalent to Malaysian MASCO 2524, so its example occupations must not be treated as a verified AI-risk rating for all Data Professionals.

potential_task_changes.interpretation: Statistical data evaluation and interpretation appear in the ILO representative occupation 2120; they overlap with some MASCO Data Professionals duties.
Database design and data-management responsibilities appear in ILO representative occupation 2521; this overlaps only with part of the Malaysian occupation.

user_facing_explanation.human_responsibilities: People still need to define useful questions, verify data quality, examine assumptions, explain findings and make domain-specific decisions.
user_facing_explanation.occupation_specific_limitations: The selected ISCO 2120 and 2521 occupations are partial task comparisons only; no single official ILO gradient or OECD numeric index is available for the full MASCO 2524 occupation.
